ordering: Publication year descending, then first public release within each year.

date_sources.arxiv: The YYMM prefix of the primary arXiv identifier records the submission month.

visual_evidence.surf: Section 2 and Figures 1–2: nonuniform traversal speed and inverse arc-length CDF; Theorem 1 requires regularity and has a finite-sampling floor.
visual_evidence.retailagent: Sections 2.1 and 3.2.1, Table 1: exposure-matched timing; intact −45.7 bps, global shuffle −3.5, same-day −8.7. The bar preview uses signed values and the reported date-bootstrap confidence intervals.
visual_evidence.birq: Section 3, Figure 1, Algorithm 1: reuse intermediate encoder features, preserve raw-input anchors, use differentiable enhanced labels; original architecture chosen over a generic WER thumbnail.
visual_evidence.efficient-penalty: Theorems 1 and 4, Figure 3: reduced O(1) smoothness with regime-specific assumptions; fully single-loop PBGD-Free is restricted to uncoupled constraints.
visual_evidence.pbgd-free: Definition 1, Algorithm 1, Theorem 3, Figure 1: single-step lower update, no value-function loop; flatness controls omitted-gradient bias.
visual_evidence.smoothness: Section III and IV, Table I: directional-derivative cancellation. Home preview is the exact toy H=x²/2+γ(y−x)² at γ=5 and F=min_y H=x²/2, not experimental data.
visual_evidence.blocc: Section 2.1, Equation 8, Figure 1: the value-function gradient includes the multiplier contribution from moving constraints.
